subject: Business Studies
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Small Business and Enterprises in CBSE Class 11 Business Studies.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Business Studies (054), Unit-8: Small Business and Enterprises covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
